# Draft:Awake purified drinking water

Introduction
Awake pure water be bottled water wey Kasapreko PLC, Ghana drink company, dey make. The brand be known well for ein CSR program wey dem dey call "One4Life".
Awake Water, dem dey sell am say e be pure water wey dem filter proper proper to make sure say e clean. E get pH level of 6.5 to 7.5, den e get some minerals inside small small. You fit find am for different sizes like 330ml, 500ml, 750ml, 1.5 litres, plus big 19 litres for dispenser. For Ghana den other African countries like Naija, you go see am dey sell plenty.
"One4Life" Initiative
The brand dey make different for town cos of their "One4Life" campaign. Like small change wey dem dey get from every bottle wey dem sell, dem dey give am go the National Cardio-thoracic Centre for Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital for Accra, Ghana. The thing be say, dem wan support people wey dey get heart problem wey money no dey dem to do treatment.
